results.title: Digital Transformation in SMEs: Enablers, Interconnections, and a ...
results.content: Unlike prior studies that focus on isolated factors (Annarelli & Palombi, 2021; Ben Slimane et al., 2022; Butt, 2020; Garzoni et al., 2020; Leal-Rodríguez et al., 2023; Nwaiwu et al., 2020; Reis et al., 2018; Yoshikuni et al., 2024), this study provides a holistic, hierarchical structure of digitalization enablers, offering a practical roadmap for SMEs to navigate their digital transformation process. Although digitalization is a costly investment, SMEs should see this process as an opportunity for business transformation (Moeuf et al., 2018). This paper presents the DASAT framework for SME digital transformation based on the TISM model, aligning with Garzoni et al.’s (2020) four-level approach, Teece’s (2007) dynamic capability view, and the work of Ardiansyah (2023), Alrub and Sánchez-Cañizares (2025), Rashidirad and Salimian (2020), and Christofi et al.
